plugins.verifyReleaseCmd: test "$(gh api repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha)" = "$GITHUB_SHA" || { echo "main moved past the verified commit $GITHUB_SHA" >&2; exit 1; }
plugins.prepareCmd: release="$(gh api repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha)" && { [ "$release" = "$GITHUB_SHA" ] || { [ "$(git rev-parse "$release^@")" = "$GITHUB_SHA" ] && git diff --quiet "$GITHUB_SHA" "$release" -- . ':(exclude)package.json' && git switch --detach "$release"; }; } || { echo "main is not the verified commit $GITHUB_SHA plus its version commit" >&2; exit 1; }
